provenance.license: Original project artwork; no third-party or concept-image pixels incorporated.
provenance.prompt:
Create one original FPV Field Kit lethal terrain tile for slot terrain.lethal. Use a restrained pixel-art style with deliberate square clusters, deep ink #070B12, panel #101923, warm text #F3F0DB, cyan #78DCE8, amber #F4BF62, hazard #F07879 and success #9DBB7A. Export exactly 16 by 16 pixels as PNG. Keep real text and functional gameplay cues separate. Preserve the slot purpose and every listed requirement. Do not reproduce reference game artwork, logos or lettering. Save the original and a separate derivative with the complete effective prompt and actual export dimensions; a prompt is not proof of a valid asset.

PRODUCTION FAMILY: Original Field Kit pixel sprites v1. Native frame 16×16; do not downsample an illustration. Use deliberate clusters, binary transparency, no gradients or antialiasing, and at most 12 opaque colors from #070b12, #101923, #182531, #425563, #647786, #a5b2bb, #f3f0db, #78dce8, #f4bf62, #f07879, #9dbb7a, #687c55. Camera/front points NORTH at the top of the frame. Keep text, gameplay hitboxes, selection badges and contact rings separate.

SLOT GEOMETRY:
{"frame":{"x":0,"y":0,"width":16,"height":16},"pivot":{"x":0.5,"y":0.5},"occupiedBounds":null,"rotorAnchors":[],"nineSlice":null}

REQUIREMENTS:
- Keep the entire 16×16 cell footprint visible.
- Differentiate material by pattern and shape as well as color.
- Do not change traversability or affected actor types.

Save an untouched source, exact-size PNG, provenance and effective prompt. Review at 20, 24, and 32 CSS pixels on ink, light and actual arena backgrounds. A candidate is produced, not reviewed. Existing earned artwork and reference/game-generated sources must remain unchanged.

evidence: Agent asset-readiness review: docs/verification/fpv-redesign/phase7/asset-visual-decisions-integrated.json#terrain.lethal. Wall structure, slow-ground weave and lethal warning pattern differ by pattern as well as color.
Scope: asset readiness only. Exact-source release, deployed byte/play/offline evidence and physical-device limits are recorded separately.
